items.summary: Recommendation: approve containment. Do not start new CRO, production, or spending initiatives this cycle. Revenue support is limited to Amazon aggregate data for 2026-09-21: 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 commission. Because the $4.92 is unattributed and covers one day while AI spend is $948.878834 from 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-26, portfolio contribution margin, ROI, and cost-to-learn are not calculable. Continue existing measurement, failed-run containment, and bounded security evidence work only. The minimum finance evidence needed is a same-period ledger mapping revenue, AI cost, attributable infrastructure cost, and any other direct cost by site and experiment; do not treat missing values as zero.

Attribution quality is insufficient for site-level revenue claims. Amazon reports 18 named tracking rows plus one aggregate row containing all 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 commission. Named site rows show $0 commission, so no site or experiment can claim revenue, margin, ROI, or causal lift. The reported 6219-click aggregate conversion rate is 28/6219 (0.45% ordered items) and 6/6219 (0.10% shipped items), but it is not attributable to any site.

Recommendation: approve containment. Revenue evidence covers one day and includes unattributed aggregate commission; AI usage covers a different period. Do not claim ROI, margin, payback, or causal lift.
